exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean section, emergency CS, planned CS)
outcome: Rate of CS among CD patients
cohort: A nationwide cohort of 3,259 patients diagnosed with celiac disease in Italy, for whom mode of delivery data was collected from 3,234.
finding: The cesarean section rate among CD patients in Italy was 40%, which is higher than rates reported in the general population over the last 40 years.
mod_finding: Emergency CS seems to be associated with an earlier onset of CD (median age of 4 years) compared to planned CS (median 7 years) and vaginal delivery (median 6 years).
